#############################################Fig.S14 & Fig.S16_iCAMP plot#########################################


library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(patchwork)

# 1. AMF

# Phylogenetic signal selection
rm(list=ls())
setwd("E:/Saline-alkali soil/Saline-alkali/amplicon/result-U/AMF/otu/iCAMP2/output0/all_ds/")
phy_sig <- read.csv("Test.PhyloSignalSummary.csv")
phy_sig2 <- na.omit(melt(phy_sig[(phy_sig$index=="RAsig.adj" | phy_sig$index=="MeanR"),c(1:3,6:11)], id=c("ds","n.min","index")))

p1_amf <- ggplot(data=phy_sig2[phy_sig2$ds <0.5 & phy_sig2$ds != 0.2,], aes(x=n.min, y=value, color=factor(variable))) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype=factor(index)), alpha=0.6) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ds, nrow=1, labeller=labeller(ds=c(
    '0.1' = "ds = 0.1",
    '0.3' = "ds = 0.3",
    '0.4' = "ds = 0.4"
  ))) +
  labs(title = "AM fungi-Parameters", x=bquote(bold('Minimal required bin size ('*N[min]*')'))) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(12,96,by=12), limits = c(12,96)) +
  scale_linetype_manual(name="Parameter type", values = c(1,2),
                        label=c("MeanR" = "R of within-bin phylo. signal", 
                                "RAsig.adj" = "Relative abundance of bins \nwith sig. phylo. signal"))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("red","purple","blue","brown","darkgreen","darkblue"),
                     label= c("pH.pearson"="pH",
                              "salt_content.pearson"="Salt content",
                              "avail_p.pearson"="Available phosphorus",
                              "tn.pearson"="Total nitrogen",
                              "tc.pearson"="Total carbon",
                              "tp.pearson"="Total phosphorus")) +
  #annotate("text", x=50, y=0.95, label=bquote('Phylogenetic signal threshold ('*d[s]~'='~'0.2'*')'), color="red", size=5) +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(color=guide_legend(title="Environment factor", order = 2), 
         linetype=guide_legend(order = 1)) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=20,face = "bold",hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title = element_text(size=15,face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size=12,color ="black",face="bold"),
        legend.title = element_text(size=15,face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size=12,face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(size=12,color ="black",face="bold"))
print(p1_amf)

# Calculation Relative importance
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), c("p1_amf")))
setwd("E:/Saline-alkali soil/Saline-alkali/amplicon/result-U/AMF/otu/iCAMP2/output/")

result_icamp <- read.csv("AMF.ProcessImportance_EachGroup.csv")
result_icamp2 <- result_icamp[result_icamp$Group %in% c("CK","CL","JP","YM","MH"), ]

result_all2 <- result_icamp2[(result_icamp2$n.min==72),c(1,5:10)]
result_all2 <- melt(result_all2,id=c("Group","ds"))

# plot
p2_amf <- ggplot(data=result_all2[result_all2$ds <0.5 & result_all2$ds != 0.2,],aes(x = factor(Group, levels = c("CK","JP","CL","MH","YM")), y = as.numeric(value)*100,fill = factor(variable))) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(data=result_all2[result_all2$ds <0.5 & result_all2$ds != 0.2 & result_all2$value >0.01,],aes(label=paste0(round(value*100),"%"), color=factor(variable)),
            position = position_stack(vjust =0.5),size=3,fontface="bold") +
  facet_wrap(~ds, nrow=1, labeller=labeller(ds=c(
    '0.1' = "ds = 0.1; Nmin = 72",
    '0.3' = "ds = 0.3; Nmin = 72",
    '0.4' = "ds = 0.4; Nmin = 72"
  ))) +
  labs(title = "AM fungi", x="Habitat", y= "Relative importance (%)") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "CK" = "Bareland",
    "CL" = "Tamarix",
    "JP" = "Suaeda",
    "MH" = "Cotton",
    "YM" = "Maize"
  )) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#3b3b3b","#5c7cbc","#d580ec","#47ced1","#fde725"),
                    label= c("HeS"="Heterogeneous selection",
                             "HoS"="Homogeneous selection",
                             "DL"="Dispersal limitation",
                             "HD"="Homogeneous dispsersal",
                             "DR"="Drift")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("white","white","white","black")) +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(fill=guide_legend(title="Process"),
         color="none") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=20,face = "bold",hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title = element_text(size=15,face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=12,color ="black",face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=12,color ="black",face="bold", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.title = element_text(size=15,face = "bold", hjust = 0),
        legend.text = element_text(size=12,face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(size=12,color ="black",face="bold"))

print(p2_amf)
